entries.head: promql
entries.message: promql: 'or' between a float-valued and a histogram-valued operand does not support a %s-shaped float operand, which cerberus issue #2333 does not cover
entries.rationale: both callers (lowerMixedExpHistogramSetOp, and — since cerberus issue #2453 — lowerSumOrAvgOverMixedExpHistogramSetOp) reach this default switch arm only when RowShapeOf(floatNode) is neither SampleRowShape, GridWindowRowShape, nor ReducedWindowRowShape, i.e. HistogramRowShape or MixedRowShape — believed unreachable through any parseable query today, since the float side already failed isExpHistogramValuedShape before lower() is called on it. A defensive guard against a future histogram-aware float lowering silently mis-projecting through this path, not a live divergence.

guard: default of switch shape over [case chplan.SampleRowShape, chplan.GridWindowRowShape, chplan.ReducedWindowRowShape; default]

entries.head: promql
entries.message: promql: 'bool' modifier is only allowed on comparison binary ops
entries.rationale: the parser rejects `bool` on non-comparison operators ("bool modifier can only be used on comparison operators"), so b.ReturnBool can never be true for the `or` BinaryExpr this function receives — a parser-level fact independent of which function calls it. Since cerberus issue #2449, lowerLabelCallOverMixedExpHistogramSetOp, lowerMathFnOverMixedExpHistogramSetOp and lowerArithmeticOverMixedExpHistogramSetOp join lowerRoot as the second, third and fourth callers, but all three hand this function the identical parser-produced BinaryExpr their own labelCallOverMixedExpHistogramSetOp, mathFnOverMixedExpHistogramSetOp and arithmeticOverMixedExpHistogramSetOp recognizers only ever matched via mixedExpHistogramSetOp — the same node lowerRoot's direct dispatch would have received — so the claim is unchanged, the same way lowerVectorSetOp's identical check for the float case and lowerExpHistogramSetOp's identical check for the both-histogram case already establish.
